description: Creates a case file, the top-level container for evidence, signatures, notifications, dossiers and chats. Generate a UUID v4 for `id`: the API returns no body, so that `id` IS the caseFileId later calls need. For `useCaseId` use the General use case `063a016a-1d62-4b7b-a24f-7cf4d1d289bf` unless a specific one is required; it must be enabled for your company.
name: case_file_create
